description: Status of a person's hosted Dev-Agent runner on Cloudflare: running or asleep, busy, when it will sleep, size, whether access is stored, and usage this month (starts, awake minutes per size, agent runs and their cost). Read-only.

user_id.description: Whose runner (one container per person). Default: you — or, if you have no Dev-Agent access in this tenant, the one person here who has. Another person's runner needs the admin role in this tenant.

name: cloud_runner_status
